rule: The side (spread) is originated first, then the total, then the moneyline.

SPREAD.label: The side (spread)
consumes: home margin distribution from the ridge, matchup and Elo families
the market line, as the benchmark only
SPREAD.why_first: The moneyline is derived from this distribution, so this stage has to exist before the moneyline can be quoted.

TOTAL.label: The total
consumes: game-total distribution from the ridge and matchup families
the market total, as the benchmark only
TOTAL.why_second: An independent target, priced after the side so that both published lines come from the same fit and the same training window.

MONEYLINE.label: The moneyline
MONEYLINE.why_third: It is a read-out of the side's distribution, so it is originated after the side and never before it.

note: Every stage is fitted walk-forward: for test season S only seasons < S are used. The market is never an input to a prediction; it is carried only as the benchmark.
